key_findings: OPN is decreased in degenerating cartilaginous endplate and is downregulated by TNF-alpha in endplate chondrocytes.
OPN deficiency raises CCL2/CCL5 to recruit macrophages and enhances NLRP3 inflammasome activation in EPCs, which MCC950 mitigates.
